user.title: Connect to Eliis
user.description: This integration uses the unofficial Eliis mobile API. It needs your Eliis account visibility, may poll personal data and will include the session cookie in Home Assistant backups. Setup is read-only apart from login.

two_factor.title: Two-factor authentication
two_factor.description: Enter the code required by Eliis to finish signing in.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Eliis
reauth_confirm.description: The Eliis session is no longer valid. Sign in again to keep the existing account and selections.

reauth_2fa.title: Reconnect with two-factor
reauth_2fa.description: Enter the code required by Eliis to finish signing in.

reconfigure.title: Update Eliis account
reconfigure.description: Sign in again to verify the account and refresh visible institutions and children. Existing selections are kept only while still visible.

reconfigure_2fa.title: Update Eliis account
reconfigure_2fa.description: Enter the code required by Eliis to finish signing in.

error.invalid_auth: Eliis rejected the username, password or code.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Eliis service.
error.rate_limited: Eliis asked this account to slow down. Try again later.
error.permission_denied: This account is not allowed to read the required data.
error.two_factor_unsupported: Eliis requested a two-factor challenge that this integration cannot complete safely.
error.no_institutions: No institution was visible to this account.
error.unknown: Unexpected error while talking to Eliis.

abort.already_configured: This Eliis account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: The signed-in account does not match this entry.
abort.reauth_failed: Could not start reauthentication for this entry.
abort.reconfigure_failed: Could not start reconfiguration for this entry.
abort.two_factor_expired: The two-factor challenge expired. Start again.

init.title: Eliis options
init.description: Choose which optional modules are polled and how often. The institution events calendar is experimental and omits recurring or ambiguous events.

data.enable_feed: Enable diary date and count summaries

diary_records.name: Diary records on latest returned date

get_menu.name: Get menu
get_menu.description: Return sanitized weekly-menu days for an Eliis institution device.

device_id.name: Institution device
device_id.description: The Eliis institution device to query.

start_date.name: Start date
start_date.description: First source date to return. Defaults to today.

end_date.name: End date
end_date.description: Last source date to return. Defaults to the start date.

get_feed_summary.name: Get feed summary
get_feed_summary.description: Return bounded guardian-feed date and count summaries for a child device.

device_id.name: Child device
device_id.description: The Eliis child device to query.

pages.name: Pages
pages.description: Number of bounded feed pages to walk (1-3).

get_status_history.name: Get status history
get_status_history.description: Return status-log records for one explicit date.

device_id.name: Child device
device_id.description: The Eliis child device to query.

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Request a coalesced refresh for one account or module.

module.name: Module
module.description: Optional module to refresh instead of the whole account.

partial_calendar.title: Eliis institution calendar is incomplete
partial_calendar.description: {count} event record(s) could not be represented safely and were omitted. Recurring, ambiguous or unsupported intervals are not shown. Do not rely on this calendar for complete scheduling or reminders; use the Eliis app for authoritative information.

auth_failed.message: Eliis rejected the stored session. Start reauthentication.

calendar_unavailable.message: Eliis events are temporarily unavailable for this account.

cannot_fetch_events.message: Could not fetch Eliis institution events.

cannot_fetch_feed.message: Could not fetch the Eliis guardian feed.

cannot_fetch_menu.message: Could not fetch the Eliis weekly menu.

cannot_fetch_status.message: Could not fetch Eliis status-log records.

child_device_required.message: This action requires an Eliis child device.

device_not_found.message: The selected device does not belong to a loaded Eliis account.

institution_device_required.message: This action requires an Eliis institution device.

invalid_date_range.message: The start date must not be after the end date.

module_not_enabled.message: The selected Eliis module is not enabled.
